title: UPI fail hua, paisa kata? Bank roz ₹100 dega?
hooks: UPI fail, paisa kat gaya? RBI aapko ₹100 roz dega!
Payment failed, money deducted? Get ₹100 daily from the bank.
UPI transaction failed? RBI says you’ll earn ₹100 each day.
hook_why: Starts with the pain point and the ₹ amount in the first four words, matching the channel’s high‑performing hook pattern.
metaphor: A highway of payments where a stalled car (failed UPI) triggers a daily fine until it moves again.

caption:
UPI fail hua, paisa kata? Bank aapko har din ₹100 dega 💸
RBI ka niyam (circular, 20 Sep 2019): dost ko bheja paisa T+1 din mein, dukaan ka T+5 din mein wapas. Der hui toh bank har din ₹100 khud dega.
Bank 30 din mein theek na kare? cms.rbi.org.in pe complaint.
Source: RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67, 20 Sep 2019
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌
kiro_checked: 19 Nov: facts checked by hand against RBI/2019-20/67 (Mint, ET); bank pays, not RBI; ₹100/day after T+1 / T+5
